info.title: ConsultLink v1 API
info.description: Target contract, not a claim that v1 controllers already exist. Read docs/refinement/WORKFLOWS.md for transaction/state semantics. Same-origin session authentication, CSRF on writes, sandbox-only payments, UTC instants, immutable pricing/policy snapshots.

servers.description: Same origin; use HTTPS outside local development.

post.summary: Cancel and record any sandbox refund
post.description: Private responses are scoped to the authenticated actor. Access to another user's object returns 404. Lock booking/payment. Before session start, cancel eligible booking; insert refund for server-calculated positive amount, event and notifications in one transaction. A failed refund stays visible for admin retry. Client full refund at >=24h; late refund 50%; consultant refund 100%, according to the frozen policy.

sessionCookie.name: JSESSIONID
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly session cookie established by login. Never supplied from sessionStorage.

Csrf.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
Csrf.description: Token from GET /auth/csrf; required on every mutation including login/register/logout.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable random key per logical command. Same key/input replays the first response; different input conflicts. Scope includes actor and operation/target; retained >=7 days.
